speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; to begin narrowing down the cause, have you noticed any numbness, tingling, or weakness in that leg?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Herniated Disc (L4-L5 or L5-S1) causing sciatica.

Based on your history of sudden onset pain during exercise radiating to the leg, this presentation is classic for a disc herniation. Given your age and the mechanism of injury, I am confident in this assessment without needing further imaging.
